H0068.def:
: stone
1) stone (large or small)
1a) common stone (in natural state)
1b) stone, as material
1b1) of tablets
1b2) marble, hewn stones
1c) precious stones, stones of fire
1d) stones containing metal (ore), tool for work or weapon
1e) weight
1f) plummet (stones of destruction) also made of metal
1g) stonelike objects, eg hailstones, stony heart, ice
1h) sacred object, as memorial Samuel set up to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines
1i) (simile)
1i1) sinking in water, motionlessness
1i2) strength, firmness, solidity
1i3) commonness
1j) (metaph)
1j1) petrified with terror
1j2) perverse, hard heart

H0001.def:
1) father of an individual
2) of God as father of his people
3) head or founder of a household, group, family, or clan
4) ancestor
4a) grandfather, forefathers - of person
4b) of people
5) originator or patron of a class, profession, or art
6) of producer, generator (fig.)
7) of benevolence and protection (fig.)
8) term of respect and honour
9) ruler or chief (spec.)
Also means: _av_ (אַב "father" H0002)

H0061.def:
1) truly, verily, surely
2) but, however, howbeit
3) contrariwise, nay rather (neg.)

H0040.def:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.20.2
§ Abimelech = "Melek is father" or "my father is king"
1) king of Gerar in Abraham's time
2) king of Gath in David's time; maybe title of Philistine kings
3) son of Gideon by a concubine
4) priest, son of Abiathar

H0014.def:
1) to be willing, consent
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be willing
1a2) to consent, yield to, accept
1a3) to desire

H0060.def:
1) mourning
1a) for the dead
1b) for rites of mourning (metaph)
1c) mourning garb
1d) period of mourning

H0056.def:
1) to mourn, lament
1a) (Qal) to mourn, lament
1a1) of humans
1a2) of inanimate objects (fig.)
1a2a) of gates
1a2b) of land
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to mourn, cause to mourn (fig.)
1c) (Hithpael)
1c1) to mourn
1c2) play the mourner

H0057.def:
1) mourning
1a) for the dead
1b) because of calamity
1c) of rites of mourning
2) mourner (subst.)
2a) for the dead
2b) for calamity

H0086.def:
1) (meaning uncertain) -a shout made to announce Joseph's chariot
1a) bow!
1b) knee
Aramaic equivalent: _ar.khu.vah_ (אַרְכֻבָּה "knee" H0755)

H0046.def:
1) strong, mighty-used only to describe God
2) the Strong-old name for God (poetic)

H0067.def:
Abel Mizraim = "meadow of Egypt"
a place east of the Jordan (perhaps "as fertile as Egypt")
Another name of _a.tad_ (אָטָד "Atad" H0329G)

H0070.def:
1) wheel, disc
1a) potter's wheel
1b) bearing-stool, midwife's stool

H0098.def:
1) pool, troubled pool
1a) troubled or muddy (gloomy) pools, marshes
1b) any pool, pond
1c) swamp reeds, reeds, rush(es)

H0076.def: blisters, boils (from root, to swell up)

H0024.def:
Month of exodus and passover (March or April)
Also named: _ni.san_ (נִיסָן "Nisan" H5212)
This name means fresh, young barley ears, barley

H0006.def:
1) perish, vanish, go astray, be destroyed
1a) (Qal)
1a1) perish, die, be exterminated
1a2) perish, vanish (fig.)
1a3) be lost, strayed
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to destroy, kill, cause to perish, to give up (as lost), exterminate
1b2) to blot out, do away with, cause to vanish, (fig.)
1b3) cause to stray, lose
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to destroy, put to death
1c1a) of divine judgment
1c2) object name of kings (fig.)
Aramaic equivalent: _a.vad_ (אֲבַד "to destroy" H0007)

H0092.def:
1) band, binding
1a) cords, bands, thongs (metaphorical of slavery)
1b) bunch of hyssop
1c) band of men, troops
1d) vault (of the heavens), firmament (binding earth to the heavens)

H0034.def:
1) in want, needy, chiefly poor, needy person
2) subject to oppression and abuse
3) needing help, deliverance from trouble, especially as delivered by God
4) general reference to lowest class

H0073.def:
1) girdle, sash, waistband
1a) of high priest
1b) of other priests
1c) of high official

H0027.def:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.11;
son of: Gideoni (H1441)
§ Abidan = "my father is judge"
a prince (ruler) of Benjamin

H0032.def:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.3.35;
father of: Zuriel (H6700)
§ Abihail = "my father is might"
1) a Levite in Moses's time
2) a Gadite
3) father of Esther
4) wife of Abishur
5) wife of Rehoboam

H0088.def:
§ Oboth = "waterskins"
undetermined site of an Israelite camp in the wilderness (perhaps at east boundary of Moab)

H0090.def:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.24.7
§ Agag = "I will overtop"
king of Amalek, spared by Saul but slain by Samuel

H0063.def:
Abel Shittim = "meadow of acacias"
place in lowlands of Moab
Another name of _shit.tim_ (שִׁטִּים "Shittim" H7851G)

H0084.def:
1) pinion, wing
1a) of bird (ostrich, eagle, dove)
1b) of God (metaph)

H0077.def:
§ Abez = "I will make white (or miry)"
a city in Issachar

H0042.def:
A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.4.6;
father of: Barak (H1301)
§ Abinoam = "my father is delight"
father of Barak, descendant of Naphtali

H0047.def:
1) mighty, valiant
1a) of men
1b) of angels
1c) of animals
1d) (metaph)
1d1) of enemies
1d2) of princes
1d3) of sacrificial objects
1e) obstinate (fig.)

H0065.def:
Abel Meholah = "meadow of dancing"
a city of Issachar, birthplace of Elisha

H0064.def:
Abel Keramim = "meadow of the vineyards"
a place in Ammon

H0078.def:
A Judge living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.12.8
§ Ibzan, "their whiteness (literally their tin - as white"
a Bethlehemite judge in time of the judges

H0072.def:
§ Ebenezer = "stone of help"
memorial stone erected by Samuel to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines-north of Jerusalem

H0059.def:
The place where the ark rested in the field of Joshua at Bethshemesh
This name means "stone"

H0041.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.7.1;
father of: Eleazar (H0499H), Uzzah (H5798A), Ahio (H0283)
§ Abinadab = "my father is noble" or "my father is willing"
1) a man of Gibeah who sheltered the ark
2) second son of Jesse, David's older brother
3) a son of Saul, slain with him by the Philistines

H0026.def:
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.25.3; married to David (H1732) and Nabal (H5037);
mother of: Chileab (H3609)
§ Abigail = "my father is joy"
1) wife of Nabal, then of David

H0052.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.26.6 and Zeruiah (H6870);
brother of: Joab (H3097) and Asahel (H6214)
§ Abishai = "my father is Jesse" or "my father is a gift"
grandson of Jesse, nephew of David via his sister Zeruiah, brother of Joab

H0037.def:
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.4; married to David (H1732);
mother of: Shephatiah (H8203)
§ Abital = "my father is (the) dew"
a wife of David

H0062.def:
Abel Beth Maachah = "meadow of the house of Maachah"
city in northern Israel near Beth Maachah

H0089.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.11;
father of: Shammah (H8037)
§ Agee = "I shall increase"
father of a warrior of David

H0045.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.31
Also named: _a.vi.el_ (אֲבִיאֵל "Abiel" H0022H)
§ Abialbon = "El (God) is my father"
one of David's mighty men (hero)

H0049.def:
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.1.3
§ Abishag = "my father is a wanderer"
David's beautiful young nurse

H0066.def:
Abel Maim = "meadow of waters"
a city in northern Israel (perhaps Abel Beth Maachah)
Another name of _a.vel bet-ma.a.khah_ (אָבֵל בֵּית־מֲעַכָה "Abel-beth-maachah" H0062)

H0069.def:
1) stone
1a) a (the) stone
1b) stone, material of idols and buildings

H0005.def:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.10
§ Abagtha = "God-given"
one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus

H0091.def:
Someone descended from Agag, a man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.15.8
Group of _a.gag_ (אֲגָג "Agag" H0090H)
§ Agagite = "I will overtop"
said of Haman, Haman the Agagite

H0003.def:
freshness, fresh green, green shoots, or greenery
Aramaic equivalent: _ev_ (אֵב "fruit" H0004)

H0011.def: Abaddon, a place of destruction, destruction, ruin

H0083.def:
1) pinion, wing
1a) of bird (dove, eagle)
1b) of Babylonian king (fig.)

H0017.def: Oh!, Woe!, (exclamation of pain - indicates desire or uneasiness)

H0094.def:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at Pro.30.1;
son of: Jakeh (H3348)
§ Agur = "gathered"
son of Jakeh, an author or compiler of Pr 30:1-33

H0055.def:
1) to roll, turn
1a) (Hithpael) to roll, roll up, billow

H0097.def:
§ Eglaim = "double reservoir"
a town in Moab

H0007.def:
1) to perish, vanish
1a) (P'al) shall perish
1b) (Aphel) destroy
1c) (Hophal) be destroyed

H0004.def:
fruit, fresh, young, greening
Aramaic of _ev_ (אֵב "greenery" H0003)
